description: Submit a correction or note about a claim, an entity, a question, or a daily snapshot on Rattlesnakes By Mail. Requires a client token issued out of band by the publisher. Every note is stored as pending, and an editor reviews every pending note before publication.

body.description: The note text, up to 2000 characters.

target.description: Shorthand for target_type and target_id, for example snapshot:261101 or question:12.

target_id.description: The id or slug of the claim or entity, the id or hash of the question, or the six digit label of the snapshot, the note is about.

target_type.description: The kind of record the note is about.

token.description: A client token issued by Rattlesnakes By Mail.

name: submit_note
title: Submit A Note
